strategy.summary: Reproduce gh-3923 / PR#10217: Logit.loglikeobs (and loglike) overflow for extreme linear predictors. In binary Logit, loglikeobs is computed as log(cdf(q*linpred)); for large negative linpred the exp inside the cdf overflows to inf, the cdf underflows to 0, and log(0) returns -inf with a RuntimeWarning. The reproducing test test_logit_loglikeobs_extreme_linpred uses warnings.simplefilter('error') and asserts finite loglikeobs/loglike matching scipy.special.log_expit(z), so it fails on the buggy commit.
